# Launching The Context Company


Full observability for AI agents, from bad tool calls, loops, and hallucinations to latency and cost, in 10 lines of code.


TCC Team


|


October 28, 2025 |


1 min read


Today we are launching The Context Company.


AI agents often fail quietly. They pick the wrong tools, loop, or hallucinate. Traditional observability shows latency and stack traces. It misses the failures that happen inside reasoning steps and tool calls.


Most teams find out when a user reports it. By then it is already too late. You end up scrolling logs, trying to piece together what the agent actually did and why it failed.


We built The Context Company so those silent failures are a first-class part of agent monitoring. We analyze traces across runs and surface bad tool calls, loops, and hallucinations next to latency, cost, and token usage.


Setup is under 10 lines of code. No refactor. We launched with Vercel AI SDK, LangChain, and LangGraph. You can also run observability locally on your laptop while you iterate.


If you are building agents, this is the starting point.


KEEP READING
